name: playful-todolist

frames.best_why: Two rows carry the finished look at once: white ticked boxes with the wavy line drawn across the words.

tagline: Ticking a task draws a wavy pen line through its label.
summary: A small dark checklist of three rows, each with a rounded checkbox and a line of text. Checking one pops in a tick and writes a squiggly hand-drawn strike across the words.
appearance: A soft dark rounded panel holds three rows: a grey rounded checkbox, a short white label and an emoji, with thin dividers between them. Completed rows show a white box with a dark tick and a loose wavy stroke running through the text.
behaviour: Clicking a checkbox springs it a little, fills the box with a tick and draws the wobbling stroke from left to right over the label. Unchecking first retracts the stroke, then the tick fades out.
demo_content: "Code in Assembly", "Present a bug as a feature" and "Push to prod on a Friday", each with an emoji.
search_phrases: todo list with a squiggly strike on done
hand drawn line crossing out a finished task
animated task list for a product page
wobbly pen strike through completed items
to do list card with emoji labels
how to animate a line through completed text
use_when: A small checklist in a demo or side panel wants a tactile, handwritten reward when an item is finished.
avoid_when: The three tasks and their emoji are fixed in the file, and the strike is one SVG path sized for a single short line.
customise: The tasks, emoji and starting checked flags live in the items array inside the file; the panel follows neutral theme tokens. New labels mean editing that array and checking the strike still fits.
weight_why: Three static rows with a short path-draw animation and nothing looping at rest.

a11y.note: The ticks are real labelled checkboxes with a visible focus ring; the drawing animation never checks prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The strike is a fixed 340px path, so it overshoots short labels and would clip on longer ones.
Tasks, emoji and starting states are hardcoded, so the list cannot take real data as it stands.
polish_why: Charming hand-drawn strike and springy ticks; the fixed stroke muddles short labels.
